content:
Day One: Arrival in Tokyo  
Thou shalt land at Narita and take the train to thy lodging in Shibuya.  
There thou mayst rest and wander the neon streets as night doth fall.  

Day Two: Exploration of Tokyo  
Morning thou shalt visit the Meiji Shrine where peace doth dwell.  
Afternoon thou shalt stroll through Harajuku and taste crepes sweet.  
Evening thou shalt view the city from Tokyo Tower lights ablaze.  

Day Three: Journey to Kyoto  
By dawn thou shalt board the Shinkansen swift and silent.  
Arriving in Kyoto thou shalt settle in a ryokan near Gion.  
Twilight thou shalt walk the lantern lanes and see geisha glide.  

Day Four: Temples and Gardens  
Morning thou shalt admire Kinkakuji the Golden Pavilion gleam.  
Afternoon thou shalt wander the moss garden of Saihoji.  
Evening thou shalt partake in a tea ceremony calm and deep.  

Day Five: Nara Day Trip  
Early rise thou shalt take the train to Nara where deer roam free.  
Thou shalt see Todaiji housing the great Buddha statue grand.  
Return to Kyoto thy heart filled with ancient wonder.  

Day Six: Osaka Adventures  
Morning thou shalt travel to Osaka the kitchen of the realm.  
Thou shalt feast upon takoyaki and okonomiyaki hot and tasty.  
Afternoon thou shalt explore Osaka Castle walls mighty and tall.  
Night thou shalt enjoy Dotonbori neon reflections on the canal.  

Day Seven: Return to Tokyo  
Morning thou shalt ride the Shinkansen back to Tokyo.  
Thou shalt spend thy final hours in Akihabara electric and bright.  
Evening thou shalt depart from Narita carrying memories like cherished scrolls.
